description: Search active GunBroker firearms-marketplace listings by keyword (e.g. "Glock 19", "AR-15 lower", "Henri 22 rifle"). Returns matching live listings with item IDs, titles, current/buy-now prices, bid counts, and time left. Public — needs only a GunBroker developer key (_apiKey). Supports pagination and sort.

Sort.description: GunBroker sort code (e.g. 0=best match, 1=ending soonest, 13=lowest price). Optional.
